mechanism: The shared low-WORD value transfer formerly recognized LSL by mnemonic but discarded ASL. Both zero-fill left shifts now use generated operation/direction/fill/count-source metadata. CCR differences are outside this value-only domain. No target addresses, table counts, new types or reader seeds.

coverage.positive: Immediate and known-register WORD shift, truncating overflow, bounded typed arrays, closed DBF hardware families, original LSL and MULU.
coverage.negative: BYTE/LONG scope, unknown value/count, count outside unchanged 0..15 supported range, negative out-of-prefix index, partial overwrite, opaque call, right/rotate/extend forms.

validation.framework_iteration: Four red ASL closed-family fixtures, metadata-driven repair, 89 focused green cases and 832 native green cases, then one full same-fact generation.

limits: This recovers known indexed directory-field accesses, not new string identities, runtime observations or all-path/index-domain closure.
The original two opaque indirect jumps read the reset PC from address4 after loading SSP from0. Their targets need boot-vector state, not plausible orphan code promotion.

Canonical memory-cell-to-register return summaries remain a separate ABI extension: existing inferred returns express register/stack identity, not a durable absolute/app-cell input. Saved paired fixtures establish inline-cell success versus callee-cell loss. That extension is not a prerequisite for independent source restoration.
Unseen loader/interrupt/callback and mutated storage paths retain prior limits. Original exact bytes are distinct from semantic completeness.
next_experiment: Use the reduced inventory to inspect connected object-reader/constructor contexts and remaining scalar indexed accesses. For the header chain, first establish the original source-owned holder and alias/call obligations before adding a canonical cell input/result relation.
performance_conclusion: One measured target qualification; no causal speedup claim or timing-only repeat.
